glean_search_config.description: Glean Search configuration. When omitted, Glean Search is disabled for the agent. An empty object searches all company knowledge available to the invoking user. Populated lists restrict search to the union of the listed datasource instances and URLs.

knowledge_profile_id.description: ID of a knowledge profile whose permissions Glean Search uses instead of the invoking user's permissions.

datasource_instances.description: Datasource instance names that search is restricted to. Each name selects one instance, not every instance of a datasource type.

items.description: Datasource instance name. The default instance of a datasource uses the datasource name, for example `confluence`.

urls.description: Document or folder URLs that search is restricted to. Folder URLs include every document contained in the folder.

x-enumDescriptions.FAST: Low reasoning effort for latency-sensitive, narrow tasks.

trigger.description: How the agent is invoked. Applies to top-level agents only.

x-enumDescriptions.CHAT_MESSAGE: The user converses with the agent.
x-enumDescriptions.INPUT_FORM: The agent runs on typed input fields, or with no input when none are declared.
x-enumDescriptions.CONTENT_TRIGGER: The agent runs on a document event.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CHAT_MESSAGE: The user converses with the agent.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.INPUT_FORM: The agent runs on typed input fields, or with no input when none are declared.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CONTENT_TRIGGER: The agent runs on a document event.

input_fields.description: Typed inputs collected when the agent is invoked. Valid for INPUT_FORM and CONTENT_TRIGGER. An INPUT_FORM trigger without input fields runs with no input.

items.description: A typed input of the agent, referenced from the instructions as `[[display_name]]`.

display_name.description: Label of the field and its placeholder name in the instructions. Unique within the agent.

type.description: Type of an agent input field.

x-enumDescriptions.SELECT: One choice from the declared options.
x-enumDescriptions.DOCUMENT: Glean file ID of an uploaded file.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.SELECT: One choice from the declared options.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DOCUMENT: Glean file ID of an uploaded file.

default_value.description: Pre-filled value. For SELECT fields, one of the option values. For DATE fields, a `YYYY-MM-DD` date.

is_optional.description: Whether the field accepts empty input. Defaults to false.

items.description: A choice of a SELECT input field.

value.description: Value substituted into the field's placeholder.

items.title: PlatformAgentInputFieldOption
PlatformAgentInputField

schedule.description: Wall-clock schedule for INPUT_FORM and CHAT_MESSAGE agents.

frequency.description: Five-field Unix cron expression, for example `0 9 * * 1-5`.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, for example `America/Los_Angeles`.

start_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit offset before which the schedule stays dormant.

schedule.title: PlatformAgentSchedule

prompts.description: Conversation starters. Valid only for CHAT_MESSAGE.

items.description: A conversation starter whose template is sent as the first chat message.

display_name.description: Short title of the conversation starter.

template.description: Chat message that starts the conversation. May contain `[[variable_name]]` placeholders.

items.title: PlatformAgentPrompt

content.description: Document events that run a CONTENT_TRIGGER agent.

triggers.description: Event subscriptions. The agent runs when any entry matches.

items.description: A subscribed document event and the filters that narrow it.

datasource.description: Event source in enum form, for example `JIRA`.

time_offset_seconds.description: Seconds before an event time carried in the document at which the agent runs. Pre-event triggers only.

filters.description: Filters on the document that fired the event. Every filter must match for the entry to fire. Without filters, every event for this entry fires.

items.description: A filter on the document that fired a content trigger. Values are ORed.

field.description: `TITLE` or `CONTENT` for the document's title or body, or a facet key.

operator.description: Operator of a content trigger filter.

x-enumDescriptions.IS_ONE_OF: The field equals one of the values.
x-enumDescriptions.IS_NOT_ONE_OF: The field equals none of the values. Not valid for TITLE or CONTENT.
x-enumDescriptions.CONTAINS: The field contains one of the values.
x-enumDescriptions.FIELD_CHANGED: The field changed in the event. Not valid for TITLE or CONTENT.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.IS_ONE_OF: The field equals one of the values.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.IS_NOT_ONE_OF: The field equals none of the values. Not valid for TITLE or CONTENT.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CONTAINS: The field contains one of the values.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.FIELD_CHANGED: The field changed in the event. Not valid for TITLE or CONTENT.

operator.title: PlatformAgentContentTriggerFilterOperator

values.description: Match values. Required except for FIELD_CHANGED.

items.description: A match value.

items.title: PlatformAgentContentTriggerFilter
PlatformAgentContentTrigger

created_by.description: Person who created the agent. Omitted when the agent hides attribution.
created_by.title: PlatformPersonReference

updated_by.description: Person who last updated the agent. Omitted when the agent hides attribution.
updated_by.title: PlatformPersonReference

updated_at.description: Time the agent was last updated.
